summary: Complete 5-phase strategy audit and course correction report. Phase 1 audits all 13 research files and finds severe data corruption (1M+ subscriber count errors across files), direct strategic contradictions, and 0 published videos after 4 days of research. Phase 2 applies 80/20 analysis showing topic selection and thumbnails drive 80% of results, not niche research. Phase 3 presents fresh outlier data from the last 90 days showing specific topics getting massive views from tiny channels. Phase 4 presents 3 options with Option B (Topic-First, Niche-Later) as the clear winner. Phase 5 answers the fresh conversation question. Includes a concrete 5-video starter pack with specific topics proven by real outlier data.
